candidates.subject: solutions for hard tokens

candidates.subject: Multi-factor authenticators at AAL3
candidates.object: hardware cryptographic modules validated at FIPS 140 Level 2 overall with at least FIPS 140 Level 3 for physical security, which exceeds the EPCS MFA requirements
candidates.evidence: According to NIST SP 800-63B Section 4.3 , multi-factor authenticators used at AAL3 shall rely on hardware cryptographic modules validated at FIPS 140 Level 2 overall with at least FIPS 140 Level 3 for physical security, which exceeds the EPCS MFA requirements.
